gaps.sentence: My laptop ___ (service) next week, so back up your files beforehand.
gaps.explanation: 'Next week' takes the future passive: will be + serviced (is being serviced is also a valid arrangement).

gaps.sentence: Construction ___ (halt) after the discovery of Roman remains.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + halted. The halting authority is unnamed.
The policy receives the action: 'will be introduced'.

gaps.sentence: This bridge ___ repaired twice this year already.
gaps.explanation: 'Already' + present perfect passive: has been repaired.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium ___ by the end of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'By the end of the decade' needs future perfect passive: will have been + completed. The stadium is completed by somebody.

gaps.sentence: The Eiffel Tower ___ (design) by Gustave Eiffel's engineering firm.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive with agent: was designed by. Historical events take past simple.

gaps.sentence: Endangered plants ___ (not pick) anywhere in the reserve.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of prohibition: must not be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript is said ___ in a private vault for decades.
gaps.explanation: 'For decades' before now: perfect passive infinitive to have been + kept.
